brief: A note-taking app in 3D space — recent notes float near, old ones drift away, connections are threads

dominant_strengths: Clear depth metaphor: scale and opacity convincingly suggest recent vs aged notes drifting in 3D space.
Restrained color-coded category dots add information density without breaking the dark, calm palette.
Typography hierarchy inside cards is clean and legible, with consistent timestamp treatment as a quiet meta-layer.
dominant_weaknesses: Connection threads are barely visible, undermining the core 'threads between notes' premise of the brief.
Spatial layout feels arbitrary rather than semantic — proximity doesn't clearly map to topic, time, or relation.
No visible affordances for navigating depth (zoom, pan, focus), so the 3D conceit reads as static decoration.
fix_priorities: Strengthen thread rendering with weighted, glowing edges that carry meaning (recency, relation strength).
Introduce explicit depth controls and parallax-on-hover to make the 3D space feel inhabitable, not pictorial.
Establish a spatial logic — clusters by topic or time axis — so position communicates structure.
Add a focused-note state with smooth camera framing to anchor reading inside the floating field.
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral atmosphere is strong, reflective concept is intriguing, but behavioral usability lags due to invisible threads and missing navigation affordances.
rationale.intent_fit: Partially delivers the floating-notes-in-3D concept visually, but the 'threads as connections' promise is too faint to be legible.
